locationText: Round the back of 22 Park Lane, Offerton, Stockport, SK1 4JS. On the way to Woodbank — follow the smell.
soupText:
The soup changes with what's good — ask us what's on. Our fennel sausage & white bean soup is a regular — rich, slow-cooked, exactly the kind of thing you want after an hour in the cold.
Always served with fresh focaccia on the side.
focacciaText:
Baked fresh on site. Good olive oil, good salt, good bread. Take a piece with your soup, your pizza, or just on its own. It won't last long.
Available to take away too — whole pieces while they last.
